>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Updates profile data for an existing Qubriux customer identified by mobile number,
email, or app-level customer ID. Use this endpoint to sync profile changes from your
system — name corrections, consent updates, or new contact details — into Qubriux.
The customer must already exist; this endpoint does not create new records. Supply
only the fields that have changed alongside at least one customer identifier. The
platform returns the updated customer summary including current wallet balance.
